Definition: from G4862 and a compound of G2596 and G5585; to count down in company with, i.e. enroll among:--number with.
BiblicalUsage: The lot falls upon Matthias, and he is numbered with the eleven apostles. One name is counted in, and the eleven become twelve again, because the apostleship must be full before the Spirit falls.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God numbers His servants exactly, and I hold that being counted with the eleven is no accident of the lot but the Lord's own choosing.
